rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Kantei's account 菅内閣の発足, dated 16 September 2020, says that after the new Chief Cabinet Secretary (加藤勝信) announced the list of ministers, the Imperial appointment ceremony of the Prime Minister (内閣総理大臣の親任式) and the attestation ceremony of the ministers took place at the Imperial Palace, and that at night 菅義偉, the new Prime Minister (菅義偉新内閣総理大臣), held a press conference and then the first cabinet meeting.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same account states that the Suga cabinet (菅内閣) was launched on 16 September 2020.
